description: Prioritise a host's internet-exposed CVEs: takes the CVEs from host_exposure (Shodan InternetDB) and enriches each with CISA KEV (confirmed exploited in the wild) and FIRST EPSS (exploit probability), then ranks them so the ones to patch first come first — KEV entries, then highest EPSS. Each CVE gets a priority of critical/high/medium/low. For a host name the first resolved IP is used. Keyless, read-only — one cached KEV fetch and one batched EPSS request cover every CVE.

target.description: IP address or host name, e.g. 1.1.1.1 or example.com

name: cve_triage
